title: Listen: Colpey Calling x The Fix: Bristol Jazz Festival Special
content:
19th March 2016

This week the Colpey Calling x The Fix radio show celebrated Bristol International Jazz & Blues Festival with a special show featuring jazz, afro and percussion. With Conal Dougan on guest duties.
